mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes volume depletion and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia) that enhance warfarin's anticoagulant effect and increase bleeding risk; thiazide diuretics may displace warfarin from protein binding.
action: Monitor INR closely when initiating or adjusting chlorthalidone; maintain adequate potassium levels; consider more frequent INR monitoring and potential warfarin dose adjustment.
